messages:
katie_sales: Just uploaded AcmeCorp security packet to the shared drive and dropped it in support inbox — CAIQ v5, network diagram, SOC2 cert. link: https://drive.google.com/xxx :paperclip:
andy_solutions: awesome, thanks. do we know if they included any BYOK / KMS specifics? that'll change the recommended deployment path.
mira_security: i'll take this. quick triage: did they map answers to SIG controls or is it just raw files?
katie_sales: raw CAIQ + one-pager that says 'customer-managed keys supported' but no vendor or rotation policy. no filled control mapping.
ops-bot: Ticket created: RWI-4872 — security-queue. Assigned to mira_security.
mira_security: ack RWI-4872. i'll triage and post checklist here by EOD. likely ask them for: KMS vendor, key rotation policy, data-retention table, and proof of logging/audit.
josh_engineer: from eng: if they want BYOK for the POC we need vault access and network egress rules. rough resource estimate: 2 GPU-days + 1 day infra setup for a week-long POC.
andy_solutions: acme asked if we can run the POC on hosted with stronger isolation instead of Private — they want cost delta before committing.
katie_sales: told them hosted demo ok initially but flagged BYOK as blocker. can we get a quick delta: hosted vs dedicated for a 7-day POC (estimate)? :money_with_wings:
mira_security: i'll scope security delta too. if BYOK required, hosted won't work unless we do a temporary key-wrapping workaround — which we generally avoid.
anna_pm: heads-up — contract decision targeted 2026-06-15 so security clearance needs to be done before that.
mira_security: checklist i'm going to use (posting here so it's visible):
```
1) confirm KMS vendor + key rotation
2) data flow diagram (PII in scope?)
3) logging & retention evidence (SIEM screenshots or S3 log config)
4) SOC2 scope confirmation (which services included)
5) network egress and VPC peering plan for POC
```
andy_solutions: thanks — once you confirm which items are missing i'll draft the exact Qs for the customer.
katie_sales: just messaged the customer asking for KMS vendor, rotation policy, and whether PII will be processed during the POC. sent a polite deadline (72h).
josh_engineer: also told them BYOK integrations currently support AWS KMS and Azure KeyVault only. if they propose something else we'll need platform time.
mira_security: noted. if they come back with an unsupported vendor we'll ask for key wrapping details or push for a supported path.
katie_sales: customer replied: "we can provide AWS KMS ARNs and key policy by EOD tomorrow" — forwarding. :thumbsup:
mira_security: great. i'll update RWI-4872 and mark KMS as "pending customer input". will draft required evidence requests and link them here.
andy_solutions: once KMS confirmed, can we get a quick POC quote? i'll need it to update the commercial thread.
mira_security: yes, i'll include security scoping notes for the quote.
katie_sales: i'll follow up with them after they send the ARNs. thanks all.
